ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (black) central region to high-intensity (white) distal lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black field extends from the notch through the mid-section; high-intensity white fields cover the outer lobes. Transition zones exhibit high-frequency pixel mottling. A single low-saturation tan-colored focal spot is visible in the upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes. The left lobe trailing edge displays sharp, angular peaks, while the right lobe displays slightly more rounded, high-amplitude protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly posterior-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, diagonal low-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the white field of the left lobe; several shorter, faint vertical linear disruptions on the medial edge of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multi-line rake marks on the left lobe and a distinct yellowish-brown pigmentation anomaly on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged, irregular topography on the distal tip of the left lobe compared to the more continuous right tip.
